  PERMITS AND LICENSES COMMITTEE
  MINUTES
  December 9, 2021

A meeting of the Permits and License Committee was conducted as a Call-In at 1-669-900-6833,
meeting ID 985 1970 8884 and Password 514315 on December 9, 2021 at 2:07 pm.

Roll Call:  Members Present:  Harjinder Singh, Administration
  Eddy Ikemefuna, Planning Department
  Sgt. Luis Jaramillo, Police Department
  Raul Fernandez, Public Works
  Staff Present:  Aisha L. Thompson, Secretary
  Shalanda Stringer, Finance Department
  Ruben Rodriguez, Finance Department

Public Comments Regarding Agenda Items
During public comments any person may address the Permits & License Committee, provided the
item is within the subject matter jurisdiction of the Permits & License Committee.

Chairman Singh asked if there were any persons present who wished to address the Permits &
License Committee on any item on the Agenda.

Chairman Singh reported that there were no public requests to speak.

Approval of the minutes of the meetings held on October 28, 2021.

Permit(s):
Item #1:  Subrina Miller DBA Heads Up Foundation to host a Holiday Give – a -way Event at
  400 W Beach Ave, Roger Park on Sunday, December 19, 2021, from 11:00 a.m. –
  1:00 p.m.; Subject to Approval; Applicant to hire Adequate number of licensed
  security officers for potential crowd control and the safety of those attending this
  event; Watch Commander will be notified and extra patrol will be provided as time
  permits; Person directing traffic is required to wear-highly-visible retro-reflective
  vest; Maintain site at all times, ensuring site is properly cleaned immediately at the
  end of the event; Applicant and staff members working this event shall follow all
  social distancing, protective personal hygiene and face mask wearing safety
  guidelines set forth by the LA.CO. Health Department and CA State health
  department; and Adhere to all State, Federal, LA County, and applicable Inglewood
  Municipal Code rules and regulations, including noise and signage. Motion carried
  unanimously (Activity No. 00326969)

Item #2:  Roi MAdu DBA Grand Champions Foundation to host a Grand Champions Give-a-
  way Event at 700 Warren Ln, Edward Vincent Park, on Wednesday, December 22,
  2021, from 12:00 p.m. – 4:00 p.m.; Subject to Approval; Adequate number of
  licensed security officers for potential crowd control and the safety of those
  attending this event; Watch Commander will be notified and extra patrol will be
  provided as time permits;

  Maintain site at all times, ensuring site is properly cleaned immediately at the end
  of the event; Applicant and staff members working this event shall follow all social
  distancing, protective personal hygiene and face mask wearing safety guidelines
  set forth by the LA.CO. Health Department and CA State health department; and
  Adhere to all State, Federal, LA County, and applicable Inglewood Municipal Code
  rules and regulations, including noise and signage. Motion carried unanimously
  (Activity No. 00339737)
Item #3:  Tina Gutierrez DBA Western Dental to host a Health Equity Event at 3561 W.
  Century Blvd, Private Property, on Saturday, February 12, 2021, from 11:00 a.m. –
  3:00 p.m.; Subject to Approval; Adequate number of licensed security officers for
  potential crowd control and the safety of those attending this event; Watch
  Commander will be notified and extra patrol will be provided as time permits; Traffic
  barriers must be in place before event for safety of event attendees and staff;
  Maintain site at all times, ensuring site is properly cleaned immediately at the end
  of the event; Applicant and staff members working this event shall follow all social
  distancing, protective personal hygiene and face mask wearing safety guidelines
  set forth by the LA.CO. Health Department and CA State health department; and
  Adhere to all State, Federal, LA County, and applicable Inglewood Municipal Code
  rules and regulations, including noise and signage. Motion carried unanimously
  (Activity No. 00339666)

New Tobacco Retailer License Request (s):

Item #4:  Demetrius Everson DBA Sparks Distribution to operate as a tobacco retailer at
  4683 W. Century Blvd. Approved Conditionally; Must adhere to all City of
  Inglewood Municipal Codes (IMC), specifically; CHAPTER 8: Article 8.
  REGULATIONS FOR BUSINESSES ENGAGED IN THE SALE OF TOBACCO
  PRODUCTS; Adhere to all State, Federal and Inglewood Municipal Code rules and
  regulations, including noise and signage; Sales or display of single cigarettes is
  strictly prohibited; All initial and renewal Tobacco Retailer business owners and/or
  new applicants or their designees are subject to random Permits & Licenses
  establishment inspections at any time of the day or night by any Police or Code
  Enforcement Officers, purpose of random inspections is to enforce business
  establishments to adhere to the regulations set forth by the City of Inglewood for
  Community Public Health & Safety; California State Board of Equalization Tobacco
  Retailers license must be current; NO sales of tobacco (including vaporized /
  hookah products) to any Persons under 21 years of age; All persons purchasing
  tobacco or any related tobacco products SHALL have valid ID on their person at all
  times to ensure the restriction of underage tobacco use, including hookah products;
  Submit all state tobacco renewal certificates if applicable; NO loitering of persons
  outside of the location; NO LOITERING / PANHANDLING SIGNS MUST BE
  POSTED and visible to outside of the business. Proof of signage posted by
  applicant shall be submitted to finance (i.e. photo of signage); NO use or sales of
  any narcotics or narcotic paraphernalia. Example would be; any pipes used to
  ingest other narcotics such as base / “crack” cocaine, methamphetamine. This
  would also include any glass cylindrical, tube or bubble shaped pipes used to smoke
  /ingest narcotics. Sales of Tobacco or marijuana “bongs” or pipes are permitted.
 Permits & License Committee  December 9, 2021
Minutes  Page 3 of 4

  **Sales or display of ANY weapons (i.e.; clubs, swords, knives, pepper spray,
  Taser / stun guns, etc.) and Co2 canisters aka: “whippits”are STRICTLY
  PROHIBITED!**Applicant and employees are expected to be active participants in
  calling/notifying police for police related, unusual, illegal, and/or activity that may
  necessitate a police response or response from other city government services (i.e. Code
  Enforcement, Planning, Finance, Public Works, Fire Dept., Etc.); and The following is not
  allowed inside the business without proper authorization via the P&L Committee review and
  permit: PARTIES, SOCIAL EVENTS OR GATHERINGS OF ANYKIND, :NO LIVE BANDS /
  MUSIC, DISC JOCKIES (DJ'S) PERFORMANCE, DANCE HALL, ETC. APPLICANT MUST
  HAVE REASONABLE BUSINESS HOURS (TIME OF DAY OR NIGHT) OF OPERATION.
  A Motion and seconded to have the item held over for further review. Motion carried
  unanimously (Activity No. 00326748)

New Business License Request (s):

Item #5:  Amanuel Sima DBA ICM LLC to operate as an Event Parking Lot at 211 N. Prairie.
  Ave. Approved Conditionally; APPROVED CONDITIONALLY SUBJECT TO
  THE FOLLOWING STIPULATIONS: Payment of annual business license and tax
  fees, an expired or lapsed license for more than six months will negatively impact
  your license renewal; Remittances of Parking Tax by the 20th of each month
  following collection; Parking attendant or security guard must be on site during
  event parking at all times; Ensure safe pedestrian and vehicular circulation on/off site
  and; Adhere to all State, Federal and Inglewood Municipal Code rules and
  regulations, including noise and signage. Failure to comply with any of the
  aforementioned will result in the revocation of your business license and any
  future business license application requests. A Motion and seconded to have
  the item held over for further review. Motion carried unanimously (Activity No.
  00326935)
